name: Dues Berry Farm
tagline: Link to Dues Berry Farm Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/dues.farm
description: Dues Berry Farm is a family-run farm in 152nd Street NE, WA. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through summer, autumn, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
